_meta.title: v6p4 cnn-ddqn schedule+demo-balance
_meta.summary: Fix epsilon schedule mismatch, reduce DQfD over-regularization, and raise obs_map_size for forest_a.

self_check: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v6p4 --self-check
conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v6p4 --self-check

smoke.train: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v6p4 --episodes 300 --out v6p4_smoke300
smoke.infer: conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v6p4 --models v6p4_smoke300 --runs 3 --out v6p4_smoke300

full.train: conda run -n ros2py310 python train.py --profile v6p4 --out v6p4_full3000
full.infer: conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v6p4 --models v6p4_full3000 --runs 20 --out v6p4_full3000
